svg.title: Trailhead — music video style reference (c5-trailhead)
svg.desc: A national-park screenprint poster per line: flat spot colour in silhouette layers, the lyric as the headline, the print pulled one ink per sung word. Frame is 1600x900; the strip below the frame is apparatus, not part of the film.
svg.text: SECTION VARIATION — THE SAME STYLE AT FIVE POINTS IN THE SONG
The only poster with the band on it. Inks
pulled on the beat over the intro.
"The Earth out of water and iron": a new
poster per line, the noun as the picture.
The range, the pines and a runner on the
ridge. Parallax at a run; midday palette.
No headline. The picture takes the whole sheet
Three nouns in two seconds: a triptych, each
